name: Stack Fire Ball
description: Drop a fireball through a spinning tower, smash the colored rings and keep clear of the black pieces.

content.metaDescription: Play Stack Fire Ball free online. Drop a fireball through a spinning tower, smash colored rings and avoid black pieces. Works on phone and PC.
content.about:
Stack Fire Ball gives you a flaming ball perched on top of a tall, turning tower. Every ring of the tower is built from bright colored pieces with a few black ones mixed in. Drop the ball to crash down through the colors, ring after ring, and hold back the moment a black piece rolls underneath you, because touching black ends the run on the spot.
The fun is all in the timing. The tower spins at changing speeds and the ball builds speed on the way down, so each drop is a quick choice between pushing on and waiting a beat. Breaking several rings in a row lifts your score, and every new run is a chance to beat your last one. It is free to play in your browser on a phone or a computer, which makes it a great pick for a short break.
content.howToPlay: Tap or click to let the fireball fall through the spinning tower. Break the colored rings and never land on a black section.
content.touchHint: Tap the screen to drop the fireball
tips: Watch the tower turn once before your first drop.
If a black piece is coming, pause and let it spin past.
Chain several rings together for a bigger score.
Take more care near the bottom, where the ball moves faster.

faq.q: Is Stack Fire Ball free to play?
faq.a: Yes. It is free to play in your browser, with nothing to download and no account needed.

faq.q: Can I play Stack Fire Ball on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. A single tap drops the fireball, so it works well on phones and tablets as well as computers.

faq.q: What ends a run in Stack Fire Ball?
faq.a: Landing on a black piece of the tower. Only the colored pieces can be broken.

faq.q: Does the game get harder?
faq.a: Yes. The patterns on the tower get trickier and the ball speeds up as you go deeper, so timing matters more and more.

highlights: One tap or click is all you need to play
Colored rings break, black pieces end the run
The tower spins at changing speeds
The ball speeds up the deeper you go
Endless play with a score to beat
content.goodFor: Players who like quick one-button games and chasing a high score in short breaks.

name: Drift King
description: Pick a sports car, tune it to your taste and slide sideways through corners across six 3D maps.

content.metaDescription: Play Drift King free online. Choose from 10 sports cars, tune them your way and slide through corners on 6 detailed 3D maps. No download needed.
content.about:
Drift King is a 3D drifting game where the goal is not just speed but style. You choose from 10 sports cars, head out onto one of 6 maps and throw your car sideways through the bends, leaving trails of tire smoke behind you. A neat touch is the rear-view window, where you can actually watch that smoke pour out as you slide.
Each car can be tuned, so you can change how it handles until the drifts feel just right. The detailed 3D look makes every corner feel real, and switching between cars and maps keeps sessions fresh. It plays free in your browser with nothing to install. If you enjoy car games where control and timing matter more than finishing first, this one is worth a spin.
content.howToPlay: Choose a car and a map, then build up speed and turn into corners so the car slides. Hold long, smooth drifts and adjust the tuning to suit your style.
content.touchHint: Follow the on-screen controls to steer and drift
tips: Try a few different cars, since each one slides in its own way.
Change one tuning setting at a time so you can feel the difference.
Start each drift a little before the corner rather than in it.
Practice on one map until your drifts feel smooth, then try the others.

faq.q: Is Drift King free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Drift King is free to play in your browser with nothing to download.

faq.q: What do I need to play Drift King?
faq.a: Just a modern web browser. The game runs on the page, so there is nothing to install.

faq.q: How many cars and maps are in Drift King?
faq.a: There are 10 sports cars to choose from and 6 maps to drive on.

faq.q: Can I tune my car in Drift King?
faq.a: Yes. Each car has tuning options, so you can change how it handles while drifting.

highlights: 10 sports cars to choose from
6 different maps to drift on
Tuning options for every car
Detailed 3D graphics
Watch your tire smoke in the rear-view window
content.goodFor: Car fans who care more about smooth, stylish drifts than about crossing a finish line first.

name: Love Tester
description: Type two names, tap the big heart and get a just-for-fun love score with a playful message.

content.metaDescription: Play Love Tester free online. Type two names, tap the heart and get a just-for-fun love score with a cheeky message. Works on phone, tablet and PC.
content.about:
Love Tester is a light, silly game for checking how well two names match. Type your own name, add the name of someone you like, then press the big heart in the middle of the screen. The love calculator answers right away with a percentage and a short, cheeky comment about your chances.
There is no way to win or lose, which is part of the charm. Try your name with friends, family, favorite characters or anyone you can think of, and compare the results. It is meant purely for laughs, so nobody should take the numbers seriously. It is free to play in your browser on a phone, tablet or computer, and a round takes only a few seconds.
content.howToPlay: Enter two names, then click or tap the heart to see the love percentage and a funny message. Change the names and try again as often as you like.
content.touchHint: Tap to type the names, then tap the heart
keys: Click the heart: See the result
tips: Try nicknames as well as full names and compare the scores.
Test names of friends or family for a quick laugh together.
Swap the order of the two names and see what changes.
Remember it is just for fun, so enjoy the silly messages.

faq.q: Is Love Tester free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Love Tester is free in your browser with no download and no account.

faq.q: Can I play Love Tester on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Tap to type the names and tap the heart. It works on phones, tablets and computers.

faq.q: Is the love score real?
faq.a: No. The result is made for fun and is not a real test of anything, so enjoy it as a joke.

faq.q: How many times can I try?
faq.a: As many times as you like. Change the names and press the heart again for a new result.

highlights: Type any two names and get a love percentage
A short, funny message with every result
No winning or losing, just laughs
Try as many name pairs as you like
Works with keyboard, mouse or touch
content.goodFor: Friends who want a quick laugh together, and anyone curious what a silly love score says about two names.

name: Stickman Parkour
description: Run, jump and slide a tiny stickman through 30 levels to collect golden keys and unlock each gate.

content.metaDescription: Play Stickman Parkour free online. Run, jump and slide through 30 levels, dodge spikes and swing on ropes to find every golden key. Phone and PC.
content.about:
Stickman Parkour is a platform game from FreezeNova Games Studio. You guide a small stick figure through 30 levels, and in each one you need to find a golden key that opens an old gate to the next stage. On the way you will leap over sharp spikes, swing across gaps on ropes and swim through stretches of water.
The controls are only move, jump and slide, so anyone can start in seconds. The challenge grows level by level, with tighter jumps and harder mixes of obstacles that ask for good timing. That steady climb makes it a fine choice for players who like precise platform games. It runs free in your browser, with keyboard controls on a computer and on-screen buttons on a phone.
content.howToPlay: Move, jump and slide past spikes, ropes and water to grab the golden key in each level, then reach the gate to move on.
content.touchHint: Use the on-screen buttons to move, jump and slide
keys: Left / Right or A / D: Move
tips: Look at the whole level before you start running.
Use slides to slip under low obstacles without slowing down.
Time rope swings so you let go near the top of the swing.
If a jump keeps failing, start it one step earlier.

faq.q: Is Stickman Parkour free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Stickman Parkour is free to play in your browser with nothing to install.

faq.q: Can I play Stickman Parkour on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. On phones and tablets you use on-screen buttons. On a computer you use the keyboard.

faq.q: How many levels does Stickman Parkour have?
faq.a: There are 30 levels, and each one gets a bit harder than the last.

faq.q: Who made Stickman Parkour?
faq.a: Stickman Parkour is made by FreezeNova Games Studio.

highlights: 30 levels that get harder step by step
Find a golden key in each level to open the gate
Spikes, rope swings and water sections
Simple controls: move, jump and slide
Keyboard on computers, on-screen buttons on phones
content.goodFor: Players who enjoy precise platform games and the feeling of finally clearing a tricky jump.

name: Escape Car 2
description: Race away from police cars and helicopters, grab cash on the road and unlock faster cars in the garage.

content.metaDescription: Play Escape Car 2 free online. Outrun police cars and helicopters, grab cash, fire rockets and unlock faster cars in this 3D chase. No download.
content.about:
Escape Car 2 is a 3D chase game where the police are always right behind you. Speed along desert highways and through city streets while patrol cars, armored trucks and helicopters try to box you in. Pick up the cash lying on the road, fire rockets to shake off the cars on your tail and keep going for as long as you can.
A star meter shows how wanted you are, and the chase gets more intense the longer you stay free. When things look bad you can jump into another car in the middle of the chase. Cash you collect goes toward faster cars in the garage, so each run helps the next one. It is free to play in your browser, and it suits anyone who likes fast driving games with plenty going on.
content.howToPlay: Steer through traffic, grab cash and use your boost and rockets to stay ahead of the police. Spend your cash on faster cars between runs.
content.touchHint: Follow the on-screen controls to steer and boost
keys: F or Left click: Fire rocket
Space or Right click (hold): Switch cars
tips: Save your boost for moments when the police get close.
Collect cash early so you can unlock a faster car sooner.
Switch to a new car before your current one is wrecked.
Use rockets on the cars right behind you first.

faq.q: Is Escape Car 2 free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Escape Car 2 is free to play in your browser with no download.

faq.q: How do I play Escape Car 2 on a computer?
faq.a: Steer with A and D or the arrow keys, press Shift to boost, and press F or left click to fire a rocket. Hold Space or right click to switch cars.

faq.q: What does the star meter mean?
faq.a: It shows your wanted level. The higher it climbs, the more police join the chase.

faq.q: Can I unlock new cars in Escape Car 2?
faq.a: Yes. Use the cash you collect on the road to buy faster cars in the garage.

highlights: 3D police chases on highways and city streets
Police cars, armored trucks and helicopters
Fire rockets and use a speed boost
Switch to another car during the chase
Spend collected cash on faster cars
content.goodFor: Players who like fast driving games with lots going on and a garage full of cars to unlock.

name: Guerrillas io
description: Join rooms or create battles in a 3D multiplayer shooter with teams, flags, gun upgrades, and custom weapons.

content.metaDescription: Play Guerrillas io free in your browser, join or create 3D shooter rooms with Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Gun Game, bots, and custom maps.
content.about:
Guerrillas io is an online multiplayer first-person shooter where you play as an elite fighter with weapons and gear ready for battle. Matches take place on detailed 3D maps built for close, fast gunfights. You can join an open room or create your own room from the menu. When you host, you can choose the player limit, game mode, round time, goal, bots, and map.
Each round depends on the mode you pick. Team Deathmatch splits players into two sides, Free for All makes every player fight alone, and Capture the Flag asks your team to steal the enemy flag and bring it home. Gun Game starts you with a basic weapon and lets you unlock stronger weapons as you progress. Arcade Doom gives you powerful guns and grenade launchers while making you invincible. The fun comes from choosing the right room, using the Armoury to adjust weapons, and reacting quickly in busy firefights. Guerrillas io plays free in the browser.
highlights: Create rooms with custom mode, goal, bots, time, and map
Five modes, including Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag
Armoury for guns, scopes, silencers, looks, and new weapons
Perks and custom kill messages from the main menu
Detailed 3D maps made for close, fast gunfights
content.goodFor: Good for players who like online shooters with quick room joining and several rule sets. It also suits players who enjoy tuning weapons before a fight.
content.howToPlay: Join an available room or create one, then pick a mode and enter the match. Fight enemies, support your team when the mode calls for it, and follow the goal shown by the room settings. Use the Armoury, Perks, and Kill Message menus between matches to adjust your setup.
content.touchHint: Best played with mouse and keyboard
keys: Left Shift / Q / C: Run, slide while running, crouch
1, 2, 3 / E or F / G / H: Switch weapons, pick up weapons, throw grenades, use medkit
tips: Check the room settings before joining so you know the mode, goal, bots, time, and map.
Use Capture the Flag as a team mode: focus on taking the enemy flag and returning it to your base.
In Gun Game, stay active so you can move beyond the simplest starting weapon and unlock better ones.
Visit the Armoury before a match to change weapon appearance, scope, silencer, or buy new weapons.

faq.q: Is Guerrillas io free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Guerrillas io is free to play in your browser.

faq.q: Can I play Guerrillas io on a phone or computer?
faq.a: The given controls are for mouse and keyboard, so it is best suited for a computer. No touch controls are listed.

faq.q: What is the goal in Guerrillas io?
faq.a: The goal depends on the mode and room settings. You may fight in teams, survive alone, capture the enemy flag, unlock weapons in Gun Game, or play Arcade Doom with powerful weapons.

faq.q: How do I create a room in Guerrillas io?
faq.a: Open the Rooms box on the menu and choose to create a new room. You can set the player limit, mode, round time, goal, bots, and map.

faq.q: Can I customize weapons in Guerrillas io?
faq.a: Yes. The Armoury lets you view guns, buy new weapons, change a weapon's look, adjust the scope, and add a silencer.

name: Snaker io
description: Guide a neon snake, eat pellets to grow, and avoid other snakes and your own tail in a crowded arena.

content.metaDescription: Play Snaker io free in your browser. Grow your snake with neon pellets while avoiding other snakes and your own tail in a crowded arena game.
content.about:
Snaker io is a multiplayer snake arena game with a bright 2D look. You control a small snake in a field filled with neon food pellets. The main goal is simple: collect as many pellets as you can so your snake grows. At the same time, the arena is packed with many other snakes, so every path can become risky fast. It keeps the classic snake idea, then adds the pressure of sharing the space with other players.
A round is all about movement, spacing, and quick choices. Pellets help you grow, but chasing them without looking ahead can send you into another snake or your own tail. The fun comes from balancing greed with survival: take safe food when you can, steer away from crowded lanes, and keep enough room to turn. Snaker io plays free in the browser on phones, tablets and computers.
highlights: Multiplayer snake arena with many other snakes
Neon food pellets make your snake grow
Avoid rivals and your own tail to live longer
Endless arcade play with a battle royale feel
Plays on phones, tablets and computers
content.goodFor: Snaker io is good for players who like fast arcade rounds and simple snake survival. It is also a good pick if you enjoy arena games where space control matters.
content.howToPlay: Guide your snake around the arena and collect neon pellets to grow. Avoid crashing into other snakes, and do not run into your own tail. Try to survive longer by choosing safe routes through the crowded arena.
content.touchHint: Use touch on mobile or mouse on computer
tips: Collect pellets in open space first instead of rushing into crowded areas.
Keep room on both sides of your snake so you can turn away from danger.
Do not cut too close to other snakes unless you have a clear escape path.
Watch your own tail after you grow, because tight loops become riskier.

faq.q: Is Snaker io free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Snaker io is free to play in your browser.

faq.q: Can I play Snaker io on a phone or computer?
faq.a: Yes. The game is listed as HTML5 with mobile and mouse support, so it is made for browser play on both mobile devices and computers.

faq.q: What is the goal in Snaker io?
faq.a: Collect neon food pellets to grow your snake while staying alive in the arena. You need to avoid other snakes and your own tail.

faq.q: Is Snaker io a multiplayer game?
faq.a: Yes. Snaker io is a multiplayer snake game with many other snakes sharing the same arena.

faq.q: What happens if I crash in Snaker io?
faq.a: Crashing into another snake or your own tail ends your run, so steer carefully and leave yourself room to turn. Staying clear of collisions is the key to a strong run.

name: Steal Brainrots Multiplayer
description: Grow a cash-making Brainrot base, defend your rare units, and raid other players before they raid you.

content.metaDescription: Play Steal Brainrots Multiplayer free in your browser. Build a cash-earning Brainrot base, raid rivals, use shields, and defend rare units well.
content.about:
Steal Brainrots Multiplayer is a free online multiplayer game about growing a base and keeping it safe. Your base holds Brainrot characters on collection pads, and those characters earn cash automatically over time. The goal is not only to build up your own income, but also to protect your best units while looking for chances to take valuable Brainrots from other players. Rarity matters, with Common, Rare, Epic, Mythic, Brainrot God, and Secret units all offering different cash-per-second rates.
A round mixes idle income with live PvP pressure. Your Brainrots keep earning, but an unguarded base can become an easy target for a rival. You can move around, collect or steal with the hand ability, use a lightning ability for speed, and activate a shield when you need defense. Spawn timers and random Lucky Blocks help keep new chances appearing. Steal Brainrots Multiplayer plays free in the browser with no download or account required, on desktop and mobile devices.
highlights: Build a base full of cash-earning Brainrots
Steal valuable units from other players' bases
Defend your rarest Brainrots from raids
Rarity ladder from Common to Secret units
Spawn timers and Lucky Blocks add new chances
content.goodFor: This game is good for players who like multiplayer raids, base defense, and idle-style income. It suits short sessions because your goal is easy to understand, but other players make each run risky.
content.howToPlay: Grow your base with Brainrots that earn cash per second on collection pads. Move into other players' bases to steal valuable units, then return focus to defending your own rare Brainrots. Use speed for fast movement and shield when you need protection.
content.touchHint: Use touch controls to move and use abilities
tips: Protect high-rarity Brainrots first, since rarities have different cash-per-second rates.
Do not leave your base unguarded for long after collecting or stealing; rivals can raid it too.
Use the lightning ability when you need to cross space quickly during a raid or retreat.
Watch for spawn timers and Lucky Blocks, since they can create new chances to improve your base.

faq.q: Is Steal Brainrots Multiplayer free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Steal Brainrots Multiplayer is free to play in the browser, with no download or account required.

faq.q: Can I play Steal Brainrots Multiplayer on a phone or computer?
faq.a: Yes. The game works on desktop and mobile devices directly in the browser.

faq.q: What is the goal in Steal Brainrots Multiplayer?
faq.a: Build a base of Brainrots that earn cash, steal valuable units from other players, and defend your own rare Brainrots from being taken.

faq.q: What controls does Steal Brainrots Multiplayer use?
faq.a: Move with WASD or the Arrow keys. Use the hand ability to steal or collect, the lightning ability for speed, the defensive ability for shield, Enter for chat, and mouse clicks for menus.

faq.q: What Brainrot rarities are in the game?
faq.a: Brainrots can be Common, Rare, Epic, Mythic, Brainrot God, or Secret. Each rarity can generate a different cash-per-second rate.
